pictures.scene: Vittore Carpaccio, The Vision of Saint Augustine — the writer stopped at his desk with his pen lifted and his head turned toward the light coming in at the window, today if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts
pictures.name: pd_carpaccio_stem

pictures.scene: Jacopo Bassano, Moses Striking the Rock — the water breaking out of the rock while the people crowd in with their bowls and a lamb drinks at the stream, as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness
pictures.name: pd_bassano_meriba

pictures.scene: Geertgen tot Sint Jans, Saint John the Baptist in the Wilderness — the Baptist sitting alone in the wild with his chin on his hand and the lamb beside him, where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work
pictures.name: pd_geertgen_woestijn

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, The Subsiding of the Waters of the Deluge — the ark small on the far water while the flood drains away between the bare cliffs, for forty years I was angry with that generation, they are a people whose hearts go astray
pictures.name: pd_cole_werk

pictures.scene: Hieronymus Bosch, The Pedlar — the ragged wayfarer going off down the road with his basket and his staff, turning his head back toward the house he is leaving, and they have not known My ways, so I swore on oath in My anger
pictures.name: pd_bosch_afdwalen

pictures.scene: Rembrandt van Rijn, Balaam and the Ass — the angel standing in the road with the sword drawn and raised while the donkey goes down under the rider, they shall never enter My rest
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_eed

lines.text: Today, if you hear His voice,
in the day at Massah in the wilderness,
where your fathers tested and tried Me,
though they had seen My work.
For forty years I was angry with that generation,
and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray,
and they have not known My ways.”
So I swore on oath in My anger,
